integrity: Proof uses a canonical exhaustive enumeration of reduced-row-echelon binary generator matrices, exact-bit incidence checks, and an explicit dimension-six witness; source paper arXiv:2610.23270v1 was first posted 2026-10-16.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite result for binary linear one-deletion codes, list size two, lengths one through ten only; no all-length theorem, no length-ten extremizer classification, no statement for insertion outputs.
title: Exact short-block dimensions for binary linear two-list single-deletion codes
